title: Night Shift
description: Play Night Shift, a drunk office-worker party game: flip open the phone, then stamp, copy and staple paperwork with your hands. Launch when the viewer asks to play Night Shift.

capabilities.name: sense.pose
capabilities.reason: Use your hand movements to open the phone and to stamp, copy and staple paperwork.

tools.name: start_shift
tools.description: Skip the phone intro and start a new three-job shift (stamp, copy, staple).

tools.name: enable_tracking
tools.description: Enable TV camera hand tracking after the viewer asks to play using their body.

tools.name: use_remote
tools.description: Stop camera tracking and use remote arrow controls.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read the current job, score, drunk level and time remaining.
